notes_for_editor: Brief status (relocated) matches the list's 'moved'. Brief county (Claiborne) and elevation (1,864 ft / 568.1 m) match. The Lafollette link rests on Ron Stafford's information as relayed in a note on the site's entry; the story attributes it and says it is not confirmed. The 2014 survey lists an extant Lafollette tower in Campbell County, and the list's Lafollette waypoint (CAT003) is also in Campbell County; neither source says whether they are the same structure, and the NRHP text does not mention Cline Knob, so check us-tn-lafollette before linking the two records. No build date, design, height, staffing, access or site-today detail was found in the sources reached. Brief agency is blank and none was found.
